channel.name: legs
channel.purpose: Leg and ankle: design, drop test, gait gantry

quirks: no capitals or end punctuation ever

context: Channel for Leg (left, hip to foot).
Ongoing: Leg DVT build: parts readiness and what to do about late test hardware. This week: Beth: build date holds if links arrive by Friday; Priya wants to start with rev B links.
Ongoing: Gait policy trained in sim overshoots on hardware; friction and backlash modelling. This week: Domain randomization on backlash gets 40 s of walking on the gantry.
Ongoing: Integrated DVT plan across actuators and legs and which dates are real. This week: Leg DVT build at risk from shank links and ankle impact results.
Ongoing: Leg drop gantry shared by leg drop, torso static load and ankle impact. This week: A missed Thursday slot pushes a test a full week; Zoe asks for a third slot day.
